metadata.title: A Star for Home
metadata.description: Defeat a Wither and surrender its Nether Star for a village beacon.

offer.label: A Star for Home
lines: The village can build a beacon base. The missing piece is the one that fights back.
Bring down a Wither and surrender its Nether Star. The whole village will stand in that light.
Defeat a Wither and bring back its Nether Star. I will make the reward worth the trouble.
